question: Which of the following was not a goal of 1991 economic reforms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Expand public sector control**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **1991 economic reforms**, also known as **Liberalization, Privatization, and Globalization (LPG)**, were introduced to address the balance of payments crisis and revive the Indian economy.
 
• The primary goals of these reforms included **achieving fiscal discipline**, **boosting foreign investment**, **promoting industrial competitiveness**, and **reducing government intervention in the economy**.
 
• The reforms focused on **reducing the role of the public sector** and encouraging **private sector participation** in various industries. This was contrary to the idea of "expanding public sector control."
